<thought>Search the template catalog using the flavanone SMILES and the reaction features: broken aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, formed ether oxygens, bonds formed C‑C (6-6) and C‑O (6-8), bond broken C‑O (6-8). This will return candidate templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
